_about: Listen mode rules for Contain the Sharp. Everything content-specific about WHICH audio plays and WHAT happens after lives here or in the sector's audio package, never in js/layered-sharps.js. `sectors` names each sector's package manifest (the studio's "Prototype package", unzipped as is); the page picks one from the Context lens (manufacturing | public), falling back to `defaultSector`. Trigger rules read the pre-check answers as they were when the learner chose Listen mode (frozen there). Rule kinds: "correct" (that pre-check question answered right, and confidently if confidence is ever captured) and "scoreAtMost" (an agreement score at or below `value`, on the 1-5 scale). Trigger groups: `testOut` skips that topic's part when the rule holds; `harder` plays the package's testup instead of base; `reinforce` plays reinforced instead of base. The current packages have base/universal versions only, so only testOut (K1) is live.

titles._about: Chapter names. The studio's manifests don't carry titles; a manifest `title` wins if one is added.

handBack._about: The hand-back to the screen (a ding, then "You may now continue the lesson."), played right after the listen's last part. The studio's packages don't include one, so this is the placeholder clip from the earlier hand-made package, resolved from the package's folder. Delete the key to end the listen on the closer.

sents.t: You may now continue the lesson.

checks._about: The question asked after the listen for each topic, as the deck screen whose question it is, per the version of the topic that played (missing versions fall back to normal). A topic skipped by testOut asks nothing. role: knowledge questions can trigger the review set; belief items cannot (yet).

review._about: A missed knowledge check gets that topic's fact cards, then ONE retry of the same question. After a pass, or a second miss, the learner moves on and the retry is recorded under retryKey. Belief misses (f1, f3) get no review yet — see the hook in js/layered-sharps.js (LISTEN_FEEL_HOOK).
